notes.title: Blades of Mirage will be at Bandung Gaming Days!
notes.notes:
Here are some event highlights:
[b]Local Game Competitions[/b] Witness the excitement as talented players compete in two local games, Loka Pala and Battle of Guardians, in spirited tournaments.
[b]Mobile Legends Tournament[/b] Local gamers will battle it out for the championship title and exciting prizes in this competition.
[b]Cosplay Competition[/b] Show off your creativity by dressing up as your favorite game or anime character. Become the center of attention in this colorful and imaginative cosplay event.
[b]Local Game Exhibition[/b] Discover the best works from six local game studios in Bandung, including:

[list]
[*] [b]Pamali[/b] by Storytale
[*] [b]DreadOut 2[/b] by Digital Happiness
[*] [b]The Blue Cut Hook[/b] by Plexus/Oray
[*] [b]Nightmareside The Game[/b] by Hige Studio
[*] [b]Grim Trial[/b] by Glory Jam
[*] [b]Blades of Mirage[/b] by Agate
[/list]

Don't miss out on the fun and excitement at Bandung Gaming Days 2025!

notes.title: Blades of Mirage Event Recaps. The Adventure Continues to 2025!
notes.notes:
2024 has been a year filled with exciting opportunities for the Blades of Mirage team. We had the privilege of showcasing our game at several gaming conventions, including: 

Tokyo Game Show 

Indonesia Game Expo 

IC Fest 

Gamers to Gamers (G2G) 

Indonesia Game Festival 

These events provided invaluable opportunities to connect with passionate gamers, gather valuable feedback, and build excitement for the future of Blades of Mirage. We're incredibly grateful to everyone who visited our booth and shared their enthusiasm with us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204841/878424382b2234ffb37b4abc610e314e8a6ab98d.png[/img]

The support and encouragement we received have been truly inspiring. As we move into 2025, we're committed to developing Blades of Mirage into an even more exciting and rewarding experience. 

 

Stay tuned for more updates and announcements in the new year!
